title: Orange cat rescue story

character.name: Orange Cat
character.visualDescription: a fictional orange tabby cat with a white chest and green eyes

world.name: Orange Cat Home
world.visualIdentity: small warm apartment with a blue front door, wet stone porch, narrow courtyard, and warm window light
world.architecture: ground-floor apartment with a covered porch, three stone steps, blue front door, and one glowing window
world.layout: porch outside the blue door leads to a short wet courtyard and the warm apartment window
world.lighting: cool pre-dawn rain outside with motivated warm light from the apartment window

storyBeats.description: A soaked orange tabby is pressed against the blue front door while a tiny kitten shivers beside rushing rainwater at the bottom step.
storyBeats.subject: orange-cat-v1
storyBeats.action: turns sharply toward the shivering kitten and the water rushing toward it
storyBeats.cause: rising rainwater reaches the bottom step

storyBeats.description: The orange tabby crouches at the edge of the porch and clearly sees the kitten trapped below the steps.
storyBeats.subject: orange-cat-v1
storyBeats.action: leans over the porch edge and locks its eyes on the trapped kitten
storyBeats.cause: the kitten cannot climb the wet steps
storyBeats.result: the cat identifies exactly who needs help

storyBeats.description: A fresh stream of rainwater flows across the stone toward the kitten, making the route more dangerous.
storyBeats.subject: rising rainwater and kitten
storyBeats.action: flows around the kitten's paws as the kitten backs away from the current
storyBeats.result: the kitten is pushed closer to the drain
storyBeats.framing: close detail of paws and flowing water

storyBeats.description: The orange tabby reaches down from the porch and places one paw against the kitten's shoulder to guide it away from the current.
storyBeats.subject: orange-cat-v1
storyBeats.action: extends one front paw and gently pulls the kitten away from the flowing water
storyBeats.result: the kitten moves toward the safe edge

storyBeats.description: The kitten reaches the dry step and the orange tabby pulls a small towel toward it.
storyBeats.subject: orange-cat-v1 and kitten
storyBeats.action: drags the small towel across the dry step and nudges it around the shivering kitten
storyBeats.cause: the kitten is soaked after leaving the water
storyBeats.result: the kitten is sheltered and warming
storyBeats.motion: clear towel drag and kitten movement

storyBeats.description: The orange tabby walks beside the kitten across the wet courtyard toward the warm blue door.
storyBeats.subject: orange-cat-v1 and kitten
storyBeats.action: walks slowly beside the kitten and keeps its body between the kitten and the rain

storyBeats.description: Inside the warm apartment, the kitten curls beside the orange tabby under the glowing window while rain continues outside.
storyBeats.subject: orange-cat-v1 and rescued kitten
storyBeats.action: settles beside the kitten and touches noses as both relax under the warm window light
storyBeats.result: the rescue ends with companionship and shelter
storyBeats.motion: subtle breathing and a small nose touch

storyBeats.description: The two cats rest together by the window as the first pale light of sunrise appears beyond the rain.
storyBeats.subject: orange-cat-v1 and rescued kitten
storyBeats.action: rests with one paw around the kitten while dawn brightens the window
storyBeats.cause: night has passed after the rescue
storyBeats.motion: subtle breathing and changing dawn light

script: A curious orange tabby hears a faint sound outside as rain taps against the blue front door. The cat follows the sound across the dim porch and discovers a lost kitten shivering beneath the steps. It lowers its head, calls softly, and waits until the kitten follows. Together they cross the wet courtyard, climb the stairs, and reach the warm apartment before sunrise. The rescue ends with both cats safe beside the window.
